verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows backup/restore and point-in-time restore of whole clusters/databases (cockroachdb-docs-6, cockroachdb-docs-15, cockroachdb-docs-30) and virtual cluster deployment via Cockroach Continuum (cockroachdb-docs-32), but nothing describing a git-like 'branch' concept that can be reset from its parent or rolled back independently as a lightweight dev workflow. No evidence of branch creation, branch reset, or branch-level state restoration distinct from full cluster backup/restore.
